new_value: {"description":"Implement COSE_Sign1 codec for GCP-7.1 handoff messages in C/Zephyr. Existing C stubs in coap_handoff.c. Add: (1) lichen_handoff_decode_cose_sign1 — parse COSE_Sign1 envelope, extract protected/unprotected/payload/signature; (2) verify protected alg==-65537; (3) rebuild Sig_structure per RFC 9052 → SHA256 → Schnorr48 verify via existing gcp_trust functions; (4) decode payload integer keys 1-6 (request: node, old_gw, seq, ts, expiry, rssi; confirm: node, new_gw, seq, ts, link_epoch, link_seq); (5) lichen_handoff_encode_cose_sign1 — build confirm message with signing. Test against gcp_handoff_cose_sign1.json vectors. Domain prefix must match Python/Rust (not SLOT_CLAIM: pattern)."}
